page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a catchword-like line "Tv-" at the foot right; a bracket-marked passage at the left edge of the column (no printed margin note). Running head centred at top: "EPISTOLA"; page number "14" at top left.

main_text.p: quaßet, aliaque insignia Mathematices effecta conspexißet, profecto si non Deos tamen Semideos tam splendide tam firmiter ibi contra Gigantum impetus sese fossis vallisque sepsisse pronunciasset. Si denique ipsam vrbem ingressus, ædificiorum tam priuatorum quam publicorum magnificentiam ac splendorem extus & intus oculis lustrasset, eosque ab illis ad Ampliß. Magistratum ciuesque conuertisset, nec non Reipubl. formam attendisset, non tam rempublicam ibi Platonis, Philosophantes & Mathematicos aut Philosophiæ ac Mathematices peritos magistratus exoptantis, reperisset, sed ipsos velut Platonicos Deos in vrbem vestram concessisse iurasset, quam non modo Jouì ac Mercurio sed & Palladi sacram esse, merito potuisset contestari. Quod ipsum cum & Ego maxime possim ac debeam, per decennium apud Vos versatus, idcirco Vobis Dii

page.notes: The left edge of the page is damaged and some letters near the binding are obscured; "effecta" and "Ego" are read as printed. The catchword "Tv-" is a line-end syllable at the foot. The bracket at the left of the last lines is a printed brace with no text.
